To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use of SNS have significant effects on CUI, while the perceived enjoyment has a significant indirect impact on CUI through perceived usefulness.

perceived enjoyment, structural embeddedness, and perceived usefulness all positively affect users’ CUI of SNS in the Chinese context, and the effect of structural embeddedness on CUI is mediated by perceived usefulness.

(1) perceived enjoyment has a positive effect on continuance intention; (2) perceived usefulness has a positive effect, but only indirectly, on continuance intention via confirmation; (3) confirmation has a positive effect and perceived enjoyment has a negative effect on continuance; (4) perceived enjoyment and confirmation mediate the effects of social presence on continuance; and (5) social presence has a positive effect via confirmation on continuance intention.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a major research issue in IS and SNS research and provides a comprehensive understanding of the continuance of SNS usage from a theoretical perspective.
a fundamental question in IS and SNS research: What factors lead to users’ continued usage of SNS?
the continuance intention of users of SNS, and the research model and results are expected to provide a useful reference for future studies in this area.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this research provides a better understanding of the factors that affect users’ CUI of SNS in the Chinese context.

our study contributes to IS research in the following three aspects: First, our study is the first empirical research to examine the CUI of SNS usage in the Chinese context, and our findings can provide empirical guidance for the IS research community.

our study has extended the IS continuance literature by proposing a comprehensive research model that examines both individual motivations and non-individual motivations in explaining SNS users’ continued usage intention.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a theoretical framework and conducted empirical study to investigate the continuance intention of social networking services.
we have developed a comprehensive model to explain continuance usage intention in the context of social networking services.
we have proposed a research model for CUI in SIS, which has been empirically tested in a Chinese SNS context, and our results have shown that the proposed model is valid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for SNS providers, it is important to understand how users’ individual motivations and social network structures affect their continuance usage intention.
SNS providers should pay more attention to the non-individual factors such as structural embeddedness in designing their SNS platforms.
the effects of individual motivations on CUI may be different in SNS than in other online services.
